## Sections

### Top utility bar
- Layout: Full-width strip above the main header. Left-aligned group of two contact links (email, phone), each with a small icon (16px) + text, `gap-[24px]` (--space-lg) between the two items.
- Spacing: icon-to-text gap 8px (--space-xs); left inset 76px from viewport edge (matches content max-width gutter).
- Typography: --text-xs (14px), Regular weight.
- Colors: text --color-text-muted (#4a5565); icons same tone.
- Components/states: static, no interactive states observed.
- Assets needed: mail icon, phone icon (from /src/assets/icons/, match visually).

### Main header / navigation
- Layout: Horizontal bar below the utility strip, full width, height 48px nav row. Left: logo lockup (icon mark + "RPC" wordmark + "Rudra Portable Cabins" tagline, stacked). Right: nav links (Home, About Us, Products [with dropdown chevron icon], Contact Us button).
- Spacing: nav items gap not explicit in metadata — use --space-lg (24px) between links as a reasonable default (flag if it looks off against screenshot).
- Typography: nav links --text-sm (16px) Regular; "Contact Us" rendered as a filled button.
- Colors: text --color-text (#101828); "Contact Us" button uses --color-primary (#e7000b) background, white text.
- Components/states: "Products" link has a dropdown affordance (chevron icon) — dropdown menu contents are not present in this frame (single static frame only). Treat as a menu trigger with no defined open-state content.
- Assets needed: logo mark (/src/assets/logo.png), chevron icon.

### Hero (carousel)
- Layout: Full-bleed hero, 1144×600px, with a dark overlay (`rgba(0,0,0,0.5)`) over a background photo, centered content column (max width 1024px), left-aligned heading/subheading/CTA. Metadata shows **3 stacked hero slide variants** at the same position (nodes 1:316, 1:330, 1:343), each a full duplicate frame with the third having an opacity-0 layer — this indicates a carousel/slider with 3 slides:
  1. "Innovation in Modular Living" / "Strong, Reliable & Modern Portable Cabin Solutions" / CTA "Explore Products"
  2. "Engineering Precision" / "Built for Efficiency, Comfort & Scalability" / CTA "Learn More"
  3. "Trusted Manufacturing Excellence" / "15+ Years Delivering Modular Construction Solutions" / CTA "View Our Work"
  - Below the slide content: 3 small round dot indicators (12px circles, `rgba(255,255,255,0.5)`), centered horizontally, for slide navigation.
- Spacing: content container inset 60px left/right, heading at y=204 (slide 1/2) or y=174 (slide 3, taller heading).
- Typography: H1 --text-3xl (60px) Bold, white; subheading --text-sm (16px)/--text-xl scale — verify against screenshot (rendered larger than base body, ~24-32px line-height); Regular weight, white.
- Colors: white text over dark-overlaid photo background; CTA button --color-primary background, white text, trailing arrow icon.
- Components/states: carousel auto-rotate/interval timing and manual prev/next controls are not specified in the static Figma frame — only the 3 slide states and dot indicators are visible.
- Assets needed: 3 hero background photos (from /src/assets/photo-*.jpeg — match by content to each slide), arrow icon for CTA buttons.

### Intro section ("Strength, Mobility & Modern Modular Living")
- Layout: Two-column section, 992px wide, 76px side inset. Left column (472px): heading, two paragraphs (with inline bold phrases), a 2×2 stat grid, and a "Learn More About Us" link. Right column (472px, offset x=520): single image placeholder (472×384).
- Spacing: paragraph blocks stacked with ~24px vertical gaps; stat grid items in 2 columns × 2 rows, each stat row 44px tall with 60px row gap; icon (24px) + text stack (label above sublabel) with 12px gap.
- Typography: H2 --text-2xl (36px) Bold; paragraph --text-sm (16px) Regular with bold inline spans (Bold weight, same size); stat number --text-sm (16px)/--text-xl Bold, stat sublabel --text-xs (14px) Regular muted.
- Colors: heading/paragraph --color-text / --color-text-secondary; stat icons --color-primary; link text --color-primary.
- Components/states: static content, "Learn More About Us" is a text link with trailing chevron/arrow icon.
- Assets needed: 4 stat icons (experience, projects, certification, service network), 1 illustrative photo for the right column (from /src/assets/photo-*.jpeg).

### Products & Services grid
- Layout: Full-width section, 1024px content, centered heading + subheading, then a 3×2 grid of product cards (992px wide, 3 columns × 2 rows, 16px column gap implied by even spacing, 32px row gap), followed by a centered "View All Products" button.
- Spacing: card = 309×392px; image area 192px tall, content area below with 24px padding.
- Typography: card eyebrow label --text-xs (14px) Medium (category, e.g. "Portable Cabins"); card title (H3) --text-lg (20px) Bold; card description --text-sm (16px) Regular truncated to ~2 lines; "View Details" link --text-sm (16px) Medium with trailing chevron icon.
- Colors: card image background --color-surface-alt (#f3f4f6) placeholder; title --color-text; description --color-text-secondary; "View Details" / eyebrow --color-primary.
- Components/states: 6 product cards — Portable Office Cabin, Security Guard Cabin, Marine Container, Portable Toilet Cabin, Pre-Fabricated Building, PUF Panel Cabin. Each card is a full-card link (hover state not specified — use a subtle shadow/border-lift as a reasonable default).
- Assets needed: 6 product photos (currently placeholder image nodes in Figma — map to available photos in /src/assets/, reuse/placeholder where fewer than 6 distinct photos are available; flag to orchestrator if visual fidelity requires more unique photos than were exported).

### Interior Solutions section
- Layout: Two-column section (mirrors Intro section), 992px wide, 76px inset. Left: heading, paragraph, 4-item checklist (icon + text), "Learn More" button. Right: image placeholder (472×384, offset y=49).
- Spacing: checklist items stacked, each row icon (24px) + text with 12px gap, ~38-60px vertical spacing between items (rows vary in height for wrapped items).
- Typography: H2 --text-2xl (36px) Bold; paragraph --text-sm (16px) Regular; checklist item text --text-sm (16px) Regular.
- Colors: same as Intro section token usage; "Learn More" rendered as a filled/outlined button (verify against screenshot — button has padding suggesting a bordered/filled treatment, not a plain text link like "Learn More About Us" above).
- Components/states: static; 4 checklist items — electrical installations, furniture, HVAC, sanitary/plumbing.
- Assets needed: 4 checklist bullet icons, 1 interior photo.

### Testimonials ("What Our Clients Say")
- Layout: Centered heading + subheading, then 3-column card row (992px wide, 309px per card, 340px tall).
- Spacing: card internal padding 24px; 5-star icon row (20px icons, 24px gap) at top, quote paragraph below (~60px offset), name/role/company block below that.
- Typography: heading --text-2xl (36px) Bold, centered; subheading --text-sm (16px); quote --text-sm (16px) Regular italic (metadata shows a `font-['Montserrat:Italic']` weight used 3 times — one per testimonial quote); name --text-sm (16px) Bold; role/company --text-xs (14px) Regular muted.
- Colors: quote text --color-text-secondary; name --color-text; role/company --color-text-subtle.
- Components/states: 3 testimonials — Rajesh Kumar (ABC Construction Ltd.), Priya Sharma (Tech Park Industries), Amit Patel (Global Logistics). 5-star rating icons per card (static, no partial-star states observed).
- Assets needed: star icon (repeated 15×), no photos for this section.

### Trusted by Leading Organizations (logo strip)
- Layout: Centered heading, then a 4-column × 2-row grid of organization name lockups (224px cell width, ~189-224px cell height).
- Spacing: 32px column/row gap (grid-cols repeat(4)).
- Typography: org names --text-sm (16px)/--text-xl — rendered as text-based logos (no logo image assets found for this row; likely represents wordmark-style client logos, not photographic).
- Colors: --color-text-secondary or --color-text-muted (verify against screenshot — likely a muted/grayscale treatment typical of trust-logo rows).
- Components/states: static. 8 organizations: Larsen & Toubro, Tata Projects, DLF Limited, Shapoorji Pallonji, Hindustan Construction Company, GMR Group, Godrej Properties, Reliance Infrastructure.
- Assets needed: none exported (text-based); if the intended design uses real logo marks rather than text, that's a discrepancy — see Open questions.

### CTA banner ("Ready to Get Started?")
- Layout: Full-width centered band, heading + paragraph + single centered button ("Contact Us Now" with trailing icon).
- Spacing: standard section vertical rhythm (~56-116px between heading/paragraph/button).
- Typography: H2 --text-2xl (36px) Bold, centered; paragraph --text-sm (16px), centered.
- Colors: not fully resolved from variable defs (no bound variables returned) — likely a --color-primary or --color-dark background band based on typical CTA-banner treatment; confirm against screenshot before implementing (see Open questions).
- Components/states: static, single primary button.
- Assets needed: arrow icon for button.

### Newsletter strip
- Layout: Full-width band above the footer, centered heading + subheading + inline email form (input 311px + "Subscribe" button 128px, 42px tall, no visible gap between input and button — likely a joined/attached input+button group).
- Typography: heading (H3) --text-lg (20px)/--text-xl Bold, centered; subheading --text-sm (16px) centered; input placeholder "Enter your email" --text-sm (16px).
- Colors: not resolved from variables — confirm background treatment (likely --color-dark or --color-surface) against screenshot.
- Components/states: email input (default/placeholder state only observed) + submit button. No validation/error/success states defined in this static frame.
- Assets needed: none.

### Footer
- Layout: Dark band (--color-dark #1e2939 implied), 4-column layout: (1) logo + description + GST number + 4 social icon links; (2) "Quick Links" (About Us, All Products, Contact Us); (3) "Our Products" (Portable Cabins, Marine Containers, Security Cabins, Toilet Cabins, PUF Panel Cabins); (4) "Contact Us" (address, phone, email, each with a leading icon).
- Spacing: columns in a 4×224px grid with gaps; list items 24-32px row height.
- Typography: column headings (H4) --text-sm (16px) Bold; list links --text-sm (16px) Regular; legal/GST text --text-xs (14px).
- Colors: background --color-dark; text --color-white / faint white variants (exact footer text color not returned by variable defs — treat as white/light-gray on dark, confirm against screenshot).
- Components/states: social icons are circular (40px, `rounded-[16777200px]` = fully round) filled --color-dark chips with icon glyphs — 4 links, platforms not identified by metadata (generic "Icon" names); match against screenshot (likely Facebook/Twitter/LinkedIn/Instagram based on typical count/style, but not guaranteed — see Open questions).
- Bottom bar: copyright "© 2026 Rudra Portable Cabin. All rights reserved." (left) + Privacy Policy / Terms of Service links (right), --text-xs (14px), full-width divider bar above it (not explicitly styled in metadata — use a subtle top border, e.g. --color-text-muted at low opacity).
- Assets needed: logo (from /src/assets/logo.png), 4 social platform icons, 3 contact icons (address/phone/email).

Not specified in Figma (single 1144px desktop frame only). See spec-shared.md Open questions for the recommended default approach — flagged for confirmation, not guessed as final.

## Open questions
- Social media platform icons in the footer (4 circular links) aren't identifiable by name from Figma metadata alone — coding-agent should match against `/design/reference/home-screenshot.png`; if genuinely ambiguous at that resolution, ask before guessing which platforms (e.g. don't assume Facebook/Twitter/LinkedIn/Instagram without visual confirmation).
- CTA banner and Newsletter strip background colors were not returned via `get_variable_defs` (file has no bound Figma Variables) and weren't distinguishable from the raw layout dump alone — confirm exact background treatment against the screenshot before final implementation.
- "Trusted by Leading Organizations" row renders as plain text company names in the layout data (no logo image fills detected for that section) — confirm with the user whether real client logo marks are expected here or whether text-based treatment is the intended final design.
- Hero carousel's interaction behavior (auto-rotate interval, swipe/arrow controls, transition style) is not defined by a static Figma frame — only the 3 slide end-states and dot indicators exist. Coding-agent should implement a standard auto-rotating carousel with dot navigation as a reasonable default, flagged as an assumption rather than spec.
- Product grid: only 6 unique placeholder image slots exist in Figma but only ~6-7 real photos were exportable file-wide (shared with hero/intro/interior sections) — if visually distinct photos per product card are required, more source images than what Figma exposed may be needed; flag to the user if reuse of the same photo across sections/cards looks wrong once built.
